# LegalCorp - Privacy Policy

## Data Collection

LegalCorp collects the following categories of personal information: name, email address, billing information, IP address, and usage analytics. We do not collect sensitive personal information such as biometric data or health records.

Usage analytics include pages visited, features used, time spent on the platform, and document upload frequency. This data is collected through first-party cookies and server-side logging only. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.

## Data Retention

Personal information is retained for the duration of the active account plus 90 days after termination. Billing records are retained for 7 years to comply with tax regulations. Usage analytics are anonymized after 12 months and retained indefinitely in aggregate form.

## User Rights

Users have the right to access, correct, delete, and export their personal data. Requests can be submitted through the account settings page or by emailing privacy@legalcorp.example.com. All requests are processed within 30 business days.

Users may opt out of usage analytics collection at any time through account settings. Opting out does not affect access to any Service features.
